title: mail.zakerne.com is a DNS-only pointer to third-party PrivateEmail (Namecheap) hosting infrastructure - informational, not tested
description: DNS brute-force discovered mail.zakerne.com resolving to 198.54.122.136, which is NOT a Cloudflare address and does not match zakerne.com's own A records (172.67.218.191 / 104.21.38.37). MX records for the apex domain (mx1/mx2.privateemail.com) and the SPF TXT record (v=spf1 include:spf.privateemail.com ~all) confirm the domain's email is hosted on Namecheap's PrivateEmail service, a third-party mail provider not directly controlled by the site. Per engagement scope (CDN/hosting-provider infrastructure not directly controlled by the site is out of scope), this host was NOT port-scanned, fingerprinted, or otherwise actively tested - it is recorded here purely as a DNS enumeration result for completeness.
impact: None assessed - out-of-scope third-party infrastructure. Recorded for client awareness only (e.g. to confirm this is expected/intended email hosting).
remediation: No action required from a pentest perspective. If this finding is unexpected, the client should verify mail.zakerne.com/PrivateEmail is an intentionally provisioned service.
